title: Spark execution model: DAG, jobs, stages and tasks
summary: Read a Spark workload from logical transformations down to distributed tasks.

blocks.text: Read a Spark workload from logical transformations down to distributed tasks.

items: Lazy transformations build a plan; an action asks Spark to execute it.
An action typically creates a job.
Shuffle boundaries split execution into stages.
Tasks are per-partition units of work inside a stage.

provenance: Original AtlasNote V3 foundation seed authored for product integration; no third-party text or private data.
